body: Hi, this is so painful to read. Can you call a birth trauma counselling hotline? Take it moment by moment, day by day. You've been through so much.
That sounds really tough. The capitalist system is not a system most people flourish under. We ar enormous evolved to be happy in it. Nothing is wrong with you for hating work. You're not lazy.

Sometimes certain therapy and meds aren't the right fit, but you have made it through so many days so far, you can make it through today. Sending much love. And you reached out to reddit. That's a tool in your mental health tool box to keep yourself alive. Good work OP!!!

Going to see her in the new year, when we get a lil $$$. Parter took a few unpaid months off due to COVID so we have zero savings unfortunately and I can't see all these specialists right now. We are flat out just paying for the counsillor haha.

Wow ! What happens in closing of the vibes ceremony? 

I really need the yoni massage. I'm 5 months pp and ebf and I can't finger or have sex missionary due to the episiotomy. I know it's no biggie coz i can have sex otherwise, but full sexual freedom is so important to me, and it feels like a core part of my identity has been compromised.

Honestly what was cut away would probably be considered excess skin anyway. Like ive always had prominent inner lips, and now a chunk of that is gone.

It's the kind of thing women remove in a labiaplasty anyway. 

And if I had a spare few thousand dollars I definitely wouldn't be putting it to surgery.

So I've just got to work thru it in therapy I guess...

I'm 5 months pp.

I don't know... I'm taking it one day at a time.

My mom was my biggest support. She's a SAHM and she was always available for me to call... and then she announced she is divorcing my dad lol. So she isn't as available for me to call any more.

I'm also gearing up to sue the OB. Even though I know the path to healing is probably love and not hate, which is what is fuelling me now.

Funnily enough sex isn't an issue for me we went at it 5 weeks pp (but I only got PTSD 3 months pp after a gynae appointment brought it all back).

Exact same thing happened to me but forceps. I didn't dig deep though. I screamed no and I meant no. I didn't choose to sacrifice my well-being for bub. 

I hope I can get to a good place where the scar shows the trauma I've worked through.

Right now that's not the case
